name: ashby-mcp
description: Access your Ashby recruiting data — list jobs, review candidates, read resumes, manage applications, and track your hiring pipeline.

ashby_api_key.title: Ashby API Key
ashby_api_key.description: Your Ashby API key. Create one in Ashby Admin > Integrations > API Keys with candidatesRead, jobsRead, interviewsRead, candidatesWrite, and hiringProcessMetadataRead permissions.

tools.name: ashby_list_jobs
tools.description: List jobs with IDs, titles, department, location, and status.

tools.name: ashby_get_job_details
tools.description: Get full details for a specific job including description and interview stages.

tools.name: ashby_get_pipeline_summary
tools.description: Pipeline overview with candidate counts per interview stage, per job.

tools.name: ashby_get_candidate
tools.description: Get a comprehensive candidate profile with all applications.

tools.name: ashby_get_candidate_notes
tools.description: List all notes on a candidate.

tools.name: ashby_search_candidates
tools.description: Search for candidates by name or email.

tools.name: ashby_add_candidate_note
tools.description: Add an evaluation note to a candidate, visible to the hiring team.

tools.name: ashby_add_candidate_tag
tools.description: Tag a candidate with a label.

tools.name: ashby_add_lead
tools.description: Create a new candidate and add them as a lead on a job.

tools.name: ashby_get_resume
tools.description: Download and extract text from a candidate's resume.

tools.name: ashby_list_candidates_for_job
tools.description: List all candidates/applications for a specific job.

tools.name: ashby_get_application_details
tools.description: Get full application details including stage history, feedback, and evaluations.

tools.name: ashby_get_application_form_submission
tools.description: Get a candidate's submitted application form responses.

tools.name: ashby_list_applications
tools.description: List applications across all jobs with date, status, stage, and source filters.

tools.name: ashby_archive_application
tools.description: Archive an application with an optional reason and rejection email.

tools.name: ashby_bulk_archive
tools.description: Archive multiple applications at once (max 25).

tools.name: ashby_list_interview_stages
tools.description: List all interview stages across all interview plans.

tools.name: ashby_list_upcoming_interviews
tools.description: List upcoming and pending interview schedules.

tools.name: ashby_move_application_stage
tools.description: Move an application to a different interview stage.

tools.name: ashby_get_feedback
tools.description: Get submitted feedback/scorecards for an application.

tools.name: ashby_list_archive_reasons
tools.description: List available archive/rejection reasons.

tools.name: ashby_list_email_templates
tools.description: List available email templates for rejection emails.

tools.name: ashby_call_api
tools.description: Escape hatch — call any Ashby API endpoint directly with a custom JSON body.

tools.name: ashby_get_api_docs
tools.description: Reference for the Ashby API: base URL, auth, endpoint index, and common gotchas.
